purpose: UD route-plan item A step 2-3 (task 3): re-sweep the W4A16 tile config on gfx1100, retain the winner, and re-measure the min_rows crossover with the new row-conditional tiles (task 6).

changes.hipengine/kernels/hip_gfx1100/quant/gguf: Row-conditional, arch-conditional retained tiles: gfx1100 builds use 16x64 through 64 rows and 32x64 above; gfx1151 keeps 16x128 at every row count. launch() picks the library by rows; explicit HIPENGINE_IQ_WMMA_TILE_M/N env overrides still win.
Header comment updated: the Python wrapper always passes explicit tiles; the C #defaults are direct-compilation fallbacks only.

xtx.note: total ms over the 3 real shapes (5120x17408, 17408x5120, 12288x5120); 32x64 wins on every shape

w7900.note: same ordering on both gfx1100 cards; gfx1151 kept 16x128 from its own sweep where 32x64 measured 50% worse

end_to_end_published_protocol_xtx.note: the 27B UD model fits in 16.5 GiB on the XTX (24 GB)

w4a16_crossover_with_new_tiles.ffn_gate 17408x5120: crossover 8 rows (1.15x at 8; was 0.68x with the 128 tile)
w4a16_crossover_with_new_tiles.verdict: min_rows=8 is now approximately correct on gfx1100 (it was clearly wrong with the 128 tile: 0.68x everywhere at 8 rows). Keep the shared floor; a per-shape floor for ffn_down/qkv at rows 8-11 (10-25% slower there) is not worth the second variable.

limitations: The W7900 end-to-end confirmation of the tile change could not run: the peer agent resumed GPU0 work (int8 prefill gate) mid-measurement and the first attempt measured contention numbers (192.5 prefill / 4.17 decode). The W7900 leaf sweep confirms the same tile ordering; the E2E confirmation is owed when GPU0 is free.
Tile timings are min-of-5 on real tensors, single seed; the E2E A/B on the XTX is median of 3 measured runs.
